en.title: LOLPing Lite
en.subtitle: Desktop pings. Native, light and always close.
en.capturePauseHelp: Finish or cancel key recording to return to the previous running / paused state.
en.resumeHelp: Pings are paused. Click Resume or use
en.stoppedHelp: Input listeners are released. Click Start to enable desktop pings.
en.intro: Hold the trigger and drag to choose a ping. Release to place it. Ordinary input passes through.
en.lifecycle: Closing settings keeps pings running in the tray. Quit from the tray to release all listeners.
en.captureShortcut: Press Ctrl / Alt / Command plus a key
en.gameCheck: Let fullscreen games keep their clicks
en.keepLastPing: Keep the last ping until the next one
en.packHint: 9 emotes included. Download lolping-extra-emotes-1.zip from the GitHub Release assets, then import it here for the other 35. PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP custom images are supported.
en.permissionHelp: Allow LOLPing Lite in macOS Accessibility, then try again. An update may require granting access again.
en.hostRequired: Open this page from the DBX Plugin Center.
en.attribution: Based on lolPing. Code: MIT. League icons, animations and sounds © Riot Games; not covered by the MIT license. Not endorsed by Riot Games.

zh-CN.title: LOLPing Lite
zh-CN.subtitle: 在桌面随时表达一个信号，原生又轻巧。
zh-CN.capturePaused: 录制按键期间暂时暂停
zh-CN.capturePauseHelp: 完成或取消按键录制后，会回到之前的运行或暂停状态。
zh-CN.resumeHelp: 当前不会触发信号，点击“恢复”或按
zh-CN.stoppedHelp: 输入监听已释放。点击“启动”后即可使用桌面信号。
zh-CN.intro: 按住触发键并拖动选择信号，松开后显示。普通键鼠操作会继续传给下方应用。
zh-CN.lifecycle: 关闭设置后仍在托盘运行；从托盘退出会释放全部输入监听。
zh-CN.captureShortcut: 请按 Ctrl / Alt / Command 与其他键的组合
zh-CN.hintNeedModifier: 请加入 Ctrl、Alt 或 Command。
zh-CN.clickPing: 触发键 + 单击显示信号
zh-CN.emoteClick: 触发键 + 单击显示表情
zh-CN.gameCheck: 全屏游戏保留普通点击操作
zh-CN.keepLastPing: 保留最后一个信号，直到下次打信号
zh-CN.packInstalled: 扩展包已安装 · 44 个内置表情
zh-CN.packHint: 已内置 9 个表情。点击“去 GitHub 下载”，在 Release 的 Assets 中下载 lolping-extra-emotes-1.zip，再在此导入其他 35 个表情。也支持自定义 PNG、JPEG、GIF 和 WebP 图片。
zh-CN.permissionHelp: 请在 macOS 辅助功能中允许 LOLPing Lite，然后重试。更新后可能需要重新授权。
zh-CN.hostRequired: 请从 DBX 插件中心打开此页面。
zh-CN.attribution: 基于 lolPing。代码采用 MIT 许可；英雄联盟图标、动画与音效归 Riot Games 所有，不在 MIT 许可范围内。本应用未经 Riot Games 背书。
